missions.title: Dawn Run
missions.place: The Line's camp and the dock roofs
missions.beat: Dawn at the Line's camp: Echo hands Parker the insulin for the Okafor kid. On the way back the radio cuts out, smoke climbs off the camp roof and a Static pickup pulls away up the quay with Echo in the back. The Host is on every radio: the hunt is on.
missions.enemies: None. The raid is seen, not fought.

missions.title: The Yard
missions.place: Mags's yard and the container terminal
missions.beat: Mags makes Parker run the yard once and hands him his granddad's pistol on the way past. Out through the south gate, Warehouse Row and the tower ahead.
missions.moves: Flips, 360s, lean and side flip; combos

acts.title: Stage 2: Warehouse Row and the Glass District

missions.title: On Air
missions.place: Warehouse Row: the warehouse roofs to the relay mast
missions.beat: The Host goes live with Parker's name and opens the betting. The Static's first lookouts, and the Host's camera drone filming the run. On a crane by the second warehouse, a figure in a red scarf watches him go by: Juno.
missions.moves: Wall hop, wallrun; a speed gate

missions.title: Glass District
missions.place: Office towers to the roof facing the toll tower
missions.beat: Through the office floors and over the roofs. The Static are sat on every route the Line uses: someone gave them away. Juno smashes the glass walkway in front of Parker and sends him down the stairs.

missions.title: The Toll
missions.place: The Static's toll tower and the Silt bridge
missions.beat: Up the toll tower floor by floor and out onto the old road bridge over the Silt. The Host promised a surprise at the bridge, and he blows it with Parker on it.
missions.moves: Climbs, wall hop indoors; a speed gate

missions.title: Silt Line
missions.beat: The Host blows a bridge and drops Parker into the Silt. Climb back up through the Hollows before the dust gets to you.

missions.title: Meridian Mall
missions.place: The atrium, the north wing and Hargrove and Sons
missions.beat: The Static have made the mall the Host's arena. He outs Mags on air as his old producer, Juno paces Parker along the far walkway, and in the store's electronics floor every screen lights up: Echo is alive.
missions.moves: Escalators, walkways over the voids, the store well; speed gates
missions.enemies: Crawlers, leapers and a brute; bruisers and a spotter drone

missions.title: Parking Spiral
missions.beat: Juno, the Static's star hunter and an old Line courier, waits on the car park's top deck. Chase her down the spiral to a duel.
missions.moves: Ramp slides, the running loop, everything at speed

missions.title: Storm Channels
missions.place: The Ward's storm channels, car park to the rail embankment
missions.beat: The city starts rooting for Parker and he can see it: listeners wave from the walkways and one hauls a sluice open for him. The Ward hold the channels because the channels are the water.
missions.enemies: Ward troopers, shields, marksmen and gun drones

missions.title: The Rail Line
missions.place: The old rail line to the station under Calder House
missions.beat: Told by the Ward to end it, the Host changes the course live: he blows the track ahead of Parker twice. Echo's second code picks the junction.
missions.moves: Long speed run; down and back up the blown sections
missions.enemies: Ward squads and gun drones, then the Static

acts.title: Stage 6: Calder House and the Tower

missions.title: Head Office
missions.place: Calder House, lobby to the executive floor
missions.beat: Off the rail line and into Calder House. For the first time the Host is in the room: he shoots from the balconies and runs every time Parker gets close, and in his office there's a photo of him and Mags twenty years ago.
missions.moves: Kick doors, jump the glass, slide the shutters
missions.enemies: The Host (hit him for a bonus); the Static on the office floors, the Ward in the atrium

missions.title: Skybridge
missions.place: Calder House top floors and the bridge to the tower
missions.beat: Up the Host's stairs and through the tape archive to the roof. Parker reaches Echo on the skybridge, and for a few seconds they're face to face. Then the Ward drag her into the tower and blow the bridge.
missions.moves: Shaft wallruns, tank tops, the CALDER sign
missions.enemies: Static hunters in the archive; Ward squads and rifles on the roof

missions.title: The Climb
missions.place: The builders' scaffold up the outside of the broadcast tower
missions.beat: Off the broken skybridge and up the scaffold round the tower. Halfway up, Echo takes over the Host's uplink: his cameras turn to Parker, the Ward's gun drones fall, and the whole city watches the climb.
missions.moves: Ramps, climbs and wallruns round the tower; the builders' lift
missions.enemies: Static crews and Ward squads, deck by deck

missions.title: Dead Air
missions.place: The studio floors inside the broadcast tower
missions.beat: Parker fights up the tower's floors to the studio and reaches Echo, zip-tied at the console. The Host's last trap drops the mast on Parker and sets the studio burning; Echo, cut free, runs.
missions.enemies: Ward squads and the Host's elite crew, floor by floor

missions.title: Signal Out
missions.place: Out of the burning studio, over the west roofs, down to the Silt
missions.beat: You play Echo, and for the first time you are the one being chased. Parker is pinned in the burning studio; the Host comes through the smoke and hunts her himself, calling it live. She leads him down to the Silt, over a girder that holds her and not him, and the Hollows close over him on her own camera.
missions.enemies: The Host as a pursuing boss
